name: taskboard
description: A live Kanban board of the agent's tasks (TodoWrite and Task tools) in a pane beside the transcript

showFilePaths.title: Show file paths in activity
showFilePaths.description: Show the file a Read, Edit or Write touched beside the tool name (stored in the board file). Off: tool names only.

showAgentTasks.title: Show subagent tasks in labels
showAgentTasks.description: Label subagent cards with the Agent call's short task description (stored in the board file). Off: the agent type and a short id only.
